string.text: A backpack from a stalker's equipment set. You can use it as a cache for loot, but it won't hold much. Besides, you should take into account that it can be stolen, so you should put it in a secluded place.
A pill to quickly induce drowsiness.
A regular Dream brand cigarette. Harmful to smoke, but temporarily tones you up a bit.
Removable rechargeable battery for PDA. With its help you can find out the current charge of your portable computer.
A detector for measuring abnormal activity. To make measurements you need to take the device in your hands and activate it near the source of abnormal energy.
Drinking water, helps to quench thirst. Produced clearly outside the zone.
Fire-cooked rat. Much more nutritious than raw. Plus, the heat treatment killed all the viruses and parasites.
Fire-cooked crow. Much more nutritious than raw. Plus, the heat treatment has destroyed all viruses and parasites.
A box of matches. You can use it to start a fire. The fire can be used to keep warm at night or in the rain, to cook some food, and to scare away hostile monsters.

Relieves the effects of various kinds of psi radiation. By the strength of tranquilizing and anxiolytic (anti-anxiety) action surpasses other benzodiazepine and abenzodiazepine tranquilizers, also has a pronounced anticonvulsant, myorelaxant (muscle relaxant) and sleeping effect.
Help heal from the effects of a bite from an infected dog.
Power cell for servos for exoskeleton. Must be hung on the suit's belt to work.

Made by stalker Golmar and contains artifact particles. Anti-gravity sashes allow you to hover slightly above the ground. Height and distance jumps are increased. You don't have to fear falling from 20 meters high. Load capacity +20 kg.

Protective suit. Weight - 18 kg. Features: protects the body from Stun, Stinging Fluff, most anomalies and mechanical damage. Chest and back are protected by built-in biometallic plates. Equipped with a sealed metal-plastic helmet and two oxygen tanks. Warning: with prolonged use it becomes unusable - damaged and torn.

Protective suit. Weight - 8 kg. Features: protects the body from weak anomalies and mechanical damage. Equipped with an oxygen mask. Attention: with prolonged use it becomes unusable - damaged and torn.

Protective suit. Weight - 12 kg. Features: protects the body from Stun, Stinging Fluff, many anomalies and mechanical damage. Equipped with a sealed helmet and oxygen tank. Warning: with prolonged use it becomes unusable - damaged and torn.

Orange-colored protective spacesuit with hermetic helmet. Weight - 11 kg. Features: protects the body from fire, acids, gases, the effects of various anomalies, Stinging Fluff and mechanical damage. Equipped with two oxygen tanks. Attention: with prolonged use it becomes unusable - damaged and torn.

A device that detects anomalous fields and disturbances, makes clicking sounds and turns on a red light when a positive reaction is detected.
- does not detect all anomalies
- works unstably, there are failures
- if you have this device you can scan items in your backpack for radiation.

Anomaly Detector (DA-2).
A device that detects the presence of anomalous fields and disturbances. When detected, it emits a sound signal. To operate, it must be activated by placing the device on the belt.
Number of detectable zones - 3.
Detection radius 10 meters.

Universal anomaly detector (UDA-14a).
A device that detects the presence of anomalous fields and disturbances, as well as centers of radioactive contamination. When detected, it emits a sound signal and marks the anomaly on the screen. To operate, it must be activated by placing the device on the belt.
The number of zones to be detected is 4.
The detection radius is 15 meters.
Pocket PC is an indispensable device in the Zone.
Flashlight with a rather powerful lamp. Very useful thing in conditions of insufficient illumination.
Flashlight with a rather powerful lamp. Thanks to the improved transformer the battery charging time is reduced.
Medical capsules. A dosage form of medicine to treat minor wounds.
An ordinary soft wheat loaf. Apparently imported into the zone from the big earth.
Canned meat. Probably from a stalker-run army food depot.
Standard sausage. Composition is unknown, but it seems to be edible.
Vodka. It's good to drink, reduces the effects of radiation, but should not be abused
Anti-radiation drugs reduce the effects of radiation on the body. A little cure for radiation sickness.
Universal medical kit. Allows you to treat injuries of varying degrees of complexity (wounds, burns, poisoning, etc.).

Specialized medical kit to combat physical injuries and bleeding. It includes components to accelerate blood clotting, anesthetics, antibiotics and immune stimulants - Anti-rad 1pc, Medical Capsule 1pc, Bandage 1pc.

Medical kit, designed specifically for work in the Zone. The composition of the kit is selected both to combat wounds and to remove radionuclides from the body. Prevents the development of radiation sickness, as well as reduces the dose of accumulated radiation.
Designed to detect anomalous zones, as well as centers of radioactive contamination.
An ordinary six-string guitar. Stalkers like to strum a tune while sitting by the fire.
An ordinary harmonica. The simplest musical instrument in the Zone.
